name: How do I choose the right luxury property sales representative?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right luxury property sales representative?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right representative involves evaluating their experience, local market knowledge, marketing strategies, and negotiation skills, particularly within the luxury segment. Look for a track record of successful high-value sales and a clear understanding of your specific property's unique selling points. A key decision factor is assessing their network and ability to reach qualified buyers in your desired areas, such as Aventura or Key Biscayne.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a luxury representative by evaluating their experience, local market knowledge, marketing strategies, negotiation skills, and ability to reach qualified buyers.
